summary: Solidion Technology Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 5.08 and 8.01 to announce the rescheduling of its annual meeting to September 15, 2026, following a private placement closing. The filing sets deadlines for stockholder proposals under Rule 14a-8 and director nominations under Rule 14a-19, with a July 9, 2026 deadline for proposals and July 17, 2026 for universal proxy notices. These are standard procedural requirements that do not signal a special situation such as an activist campaign, strategic review, or imminent corporate event. The filing is a routine current report updating meeting logistics.
